colour.chroma_metric: Squared R-G and B-G differences; not a perceptual grade
colour.selector: source-bounded palette + localized gray seam feathering
colour.source_guard_scope: Baseline keeps original sample/physical bounds; a narrow gray seam band may introduce sparse fractional levels outside those bounds. Measure its actual errors explicitly.
colour.fractional_density_phase: Screen-anchored R2 sequence only inside the seam band, constant in time
colour.quality_tradeoff: Localized feathering may increase pixel MSE; no whole-image fractional retexturing

metric_scope: Cell texture: source-weighted jump of mean native RGB standard deviation across neighboring 8x8 cells. Solid/pattern edge: exactly zero versus nonzero within-sample grain, source cell-mean RMS contrast <=8. Sample seams include intentional fractional-density variation; report separately.
preview_scope: Source/previous/new native references; TRD qualification independently checks all actual Fuse screen bytes. AY preview uses the unchanged chip model WAV.
